# v0.1.0 release staging

`RetroArch-GBA-LCD-v0.1.0-KPA-arm64.apk` is the persistent-release-key build
prepared for KONKR Pocket ADVANCE / GT78-VN. APK binaries are intentionally
ignored by Git and should be uploaded as GitHub Release assets.

Verify any candidate against `SHA256SUMS` before installation.
